description: Receipt or invoice for a business travel expense: hotel, transport, meals

merchant_name.instruction: Name of the business that issued the receipt

receipt_date.instruction: Date of the purchase, or the check-out date for hotels, in YYYY-MM-DD format

total_amount.instruction: Total amount paid, including tax and tip

currency.instruction: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the total amount, for example EUR, JPY, USD

tax_amount.instruction: Tax included in the total (VAT, MwSt, consumption tax); 0 if not shown

category.instruction: Expense category, one of: HOTEL, TRANSPORT, MEALS, OTHER

payment_method.instruction: Payment type only, for example VISA, Mastercard, debit card, cash. Never include card numbers or digits
